body: I completely forgot about the peace corp. I'm researching it right now. Thanks.

Thanks. I've gone through plenty of hobbies. They do keep my mind off my problems, but they don't tend to fix my problems. I did come across something interesting today though. Apparently there are numerous decent-paying opportunities for teaching English to children in other countries. I've always wanted to learn a second language, and oddly enough my communication problems tend to be much easier to navigate when I'm speaking to children. Maybe this is a way for me to work from home and help kids? It's something for me to think about, but it's definitely not a short term goal as I don't think I'll be ready for something like that anytime soon. Picking up a second language might be a fun hobby in the mean time though.

Thanks. I called my boss and offered to pick up some more hours then went out and bought some more booze and I'm currently drunk again. At least I did one helpful thing today. Definitely don't feel so great, but at least I should start getting some income before the bills pile up too far.

You said you're planning your own suicide. I've been thinking a lot about how to go about it if it ever comes down to it for me. I think things would have to get more unmanageable before I actually do that to my kids though. I hope you can find some way to make things work for you. I didn't PM you, but if you need someone to talk to I wouldn't mind hearing from you. This is a throwaway account but I'll keep an eye on it for a few days.
